crossRefs.note: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
“Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

translations.web: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?
translations.bsb: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that You must keep me under guard?
translations.kjv: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch
translations.asv: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, That thou settest a watch over me?
